title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Shift Allowance of Engine Hours by Rental Period
content:
On metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment, the engine hours included in the rental follow the rental periods billed.

**Shift allowance rule.** Shift allowance follows the rental periods:

1. on an agreement whose rental time includes weekly or four-week periods, the engine hours included are 40 for each weekly period and 160 for each four-week period, plus the class's engine hours per billed day for every remaining daily, four-hour or weekend-special day (a daily period counting as one day, a four-hour period as half a day and a weekend special as 2 days);
2. on an agreement billed in daily periods only and returned on a calendar day after the due-back date, the engine hours included are the class's engine hours per billed day for every calendar day from the checkout date to the return date, both dates counted;
3. on any other agreement the engine hours included are the class's engine hours per billed day multiplied by the billed days (the daily periods billed, plus 7 for each weekly period, 28 for each four-week period, half a day for each four-hour period and 2 for a weekend special).

The rate periods are those of the rental time lines on the agreement; the dates are the date parts of the checkout, due-back and return times.

## Allowance table (class figure of 8 hours per billed day, as on the metered classes)

| Rental time lines | Returned | Engine hours included |
|---|---|---|
| 2 weekly periods and 3 daily periods | any day | 40 for each week, 80, plus 8 for each of 3 days, 24: 104 |
| 1 four-week period and 1 weekly period | any day | 160 plus 40: 200 |
| 4 daily periods, checked out 4 May, due back 7 May | 8 May, a day after the due-back date | 8 for each calendar day 4 to 8 May, 5 days: 40 |
| 3 daily periods, checked out 4 May, due back 7 May | 7 May | 8 multiplied by 3: 24 |

The dates in the table are hypothetical inputs.
